name: dirsearch
highlights: -u — Target URL(s), can use multiple flags
--raw — Load raw HTTP request from file (use `--scheme` flag to set the scheme)
--config — Full path to config file, see 'config.ini' for example (Default: config.ini)

flags.name: --version
flags.description: show program's version number and exit

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --url
flags.description: Target URL(s), can use multiple flags

flags.name: --url-file
flags.description: URL list file

flags.name: --stdin
flags.description: Read URL(s) from STDIN

flags.name: --cidr
flags.description: Target CIDR

flags.name: --raw
flags.description: Load raw HTTP request from file (use `--scheme` flag to set the scheme)

flags.name: --session
flags.description: Session file

flags.name: --config
flags.description: Full path to config file, see 'config.ini' for example (Default: config.ini)

flags.name: --wordlists
flags.description: Customize wordlists (separated by commas)

flags.name: --extensions
flags.description: Extension list separated by commas (e.g. php,asp)

flags.name: --force-extensions
flags.description: Add extensions to the end of every wordlist entry. By default dirsearch only replaces the %EXT% keyword with extensions

flags.name: --overwrite-extensions
flags.description: Overwrite other extensions in the wordlist with your extensions (selected via `-e`)

flags.name: --exclude-extensions
flags.description: Exclude extension list separated by commas (e.g. asp,jsp)

flags.name: --remove-extensions
flags.description: Remove extensions in all paths (e.g. admin.php -> admin)

flags.name: --prefixes
flags.description: Add custom prefixes to all wordlist entries (separated by commas)

flags.name: --suffixes
flags.description: Add custom suffixes to all wordlist entries, ignore directories (separated by commas)

flags.name: --uppercase
flags.description: Uppercase wordlist

flags.name: --lowercase
flags.description: Lowercase wordlist

flags.name: --capital
flags.description: Capital wordlist

flags.name: --threads
flags.description: Number of threads

flags.name: --recursive
flags.description: Brute-force recursively

flags.name: --deep-recursive
flags.description: Perform recursive scan on every directory depth (e.g. api/users -> api/)

flags.name: --force-recursive
flags.description: Do recursive brute-force for every found path, not only directories

flags.name: --max-recursion-depth
flags.description: Maximum recursion depth

flags.name: --recursion-status
flags.description: Valid status codes to perform recursive scan, support ranges (separated by commas)

flags.name: --subdirs
flags.description: Scan sub-directories of the given URL[s] (separated by commas)

flags.name: --exclude-subdirs
flags.description: Exclude the following subdirectories during recursive scan (separated by commas)

flags.name: --include-status
flags.description: Include status codes, separated by commas, support ranges (e.g. 200,300-399)

flags.name: --exclude-status
flags.description: Exclude status codes, separated by commas, support ranges (e.g. 301,500-599)

flags.name: --exclude-sizes
flags.description: Exclude responses by sizes, separated by commas (e.g. 0B,4KB)

flags.name: --exclude-text
flags.description: Exclude responses by text, can use multiple flags

flags.name: --exclude-regex
flags.description: Exclude responses by regular expression

flags.name: --exclude-redirect
flags.description: Exclude responses if this regex (or text) matches redirect URL (e.g. '/index.html')

flags.name: --exclude-response
flags.description: Exclude responses similar to response of this page, path as input (e.g. 404.html)

flags.name: --skip-on-status
flags.description: Skip target whenever hit one of these status codes, separated by commas, support ranges

flags.name: --min-response-size
flags.description: Minimum response length

flags.name: --max-response-size
flags.description: Maximum response length

flags.name: --max-time
flags.description: Maximum runtime for the scan

flags.name: --exit-on-error
flags.description: Exit whenever an error occurs

flags.name: --http-method
flags.description: HTTP method (default: GET)

flags.name: --data
flags.description: HTTP request data

flags.name: --data-file
flags.description: File contains HTTP request data

flags.name: --header
flags.description: HTTP request header, can use multiple flags

flags.name: --header-file
flags.description: File contains HTTP request headers

flags.name: --follow-redirects
flags.description: Follow HTTP redirects

flags.name: --random-agent
flags.description: Choose a random User-Agent for each request

flags.name: --auth
flags.description: Authentication credential (e.g. user:password or bearer token)

flags.name: --auth-type
flags.description: Authentication type (basic, digest, bearer, ntlm, jwt, oauth2)

flags.name: --cert-file
flags.description: File contains client-side certificate

flags.name: --key-file
flags.description: File contains client-side certificate private key (unencrypted)

flags.name: --cookie
flags.description: Connection Settings:

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Connection timeout

flags.name: --delay
flags.description: Delay between requests

flags.name: --proxy
flags.description: Proxy URL (HTTP/SOCKS), can use multiple flags

flags.name: --proxy-file
flags.description: File contains proxy servers

flags.name: --proxy-auth
flags.description: Proxy authentication credential

flags.name: --replay-proxy
flags.description: Proxy to replay with found paths

flags.name: --tor
flags.description: Use Tor network as proxy

flags.name: --scheme
flags.description: Scheme for raw request or if there is no scheme in the URL (Default: auto-detect)

flags.name: --max-rate
flags.description: Max requests per second

flags.name: --retries
flags.description: Number of retries for failed requests

flags.name: --ip
flags.description: Server IP address

flags.name: --crawl
flags.description: Crawl for new paths in responses

flags.name: --full-url
flags.description: Full URLs in the output (enabled automatically in quiet mode)

flags.name: --redirects-history
flags.description: Show redirects history

flags.name: --no-color
flags.description: No colored output

flags.name: --quiet-mode
flags.description: Quiet mode

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output file

flags.name: --format
flags.description: Report format (Available: simple, plain, json, xml, md, csv, html, sqlite)

flags.name: --log
flags.description: Log file
